detail.longDescription:
Have too many junk files on your phone? Want to uninstall infrequently used apps? Or just want to check your battery status? Clean Sweep Plus provides a set of easy-to-use tools to help you manage these daily phone management tasks.

📁 "Basic Device Management"
Junk Cleaner: Find and clean junk files 
Large File Manager: Locate large files like images, videos, and audio files
Photo Compression: Compress photos to reduce file size
Notification Cleaner: Clear notifications from the notification bar

⚙️ "App and Process Management"
App Manager: Displays installed apps for easy uninstallation
Process Manager: View background app processes

🔋 "Understand Battery Status"
Battery Management Center: Displays battery power, estimated usage time, etc
Basic Battery Information: Includes system information, battery type, and capacity

🔊 "Other Useful Tools"
Speaker Cleaner: Cleans the speaker with vibration

Clean Sweep Plus Features:
Simple Operation: Easy to use and get started.
Intuitive page: clear layout, clear function location, easy to find.
Practical functions: Contains the tools needed for daily mobile phone management to meet basic needs. ​

Let Clean Sweep Plus help you manage your phone and enjoy a refreshing user experience!
